meta.notes: An extra drop: the skeleton drops 1 to 2 minecraft:bone_block, 20 times in 100, only when a player kills it. tables names the vanilla loot tables to add to and pools the pools added to each; the vanilla pools stay. condition holds the checks the pool needs before it rolls; minecraft:all_of needs every one of its terms. The drop comes back after /reload, but a world data pack that replaces the whole table wins. Extra drops need the Fabric mod jar export.
